f.title: Prepare a Risk Management Plan in the four NOM-220 trigger cases
f.statement: In compliance with numeral 8.4.1 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016, a Risk Management Plan (PMR) is prepared when: (1) a new molecule is registered in Mexico; (2) recognition as an orphan medicine is granted for the first time in Mexico; (3) the health authority requests it on the basis of a safety concern or safety issue; or (4) the health registration holder or its legal representative has identified a safety concern or safety issue that requires it.
f.applicability: Medicines and vaccines in Mexico meeting one of the four cases.

Se registre una molécula nueva en el país. 2. Se otorgue oficio de reconocimiento por primera vez en el país como medicamento huérfano. 3. La autoridad sanitaria lo solicite con base en una preocupación de seguridad o asunto de seguridad. 4. El titular de registro sanitario o su representante legal haya identificado una preocupación de seguridad o asunto de seguridad que lo requiera.

The health authority requests it on the basis of a safety concern or safety issue. 4. The health registration holder or its legal representative has identified a safety concern or safety issue that requires it.

f.title: Structure the PMR with submission letter, safety specification, PV plan and risk minimisation plan
f.statement: The PMR shall contain: (1) a submission letter; (2) the safety specification; (3) the pharmacovigilance plan, with routine and additional activities; and (4) the risk minimisation plan, with routine and additional activities.

f.statement: Where a PMR authorised by a regulatory agency recognised by COFEPRIS is available, the Spanish version may be filed with the recognised agency's structure, provided its content complies with this guide. Mexico-specific activities not contained in that plan may be included as an annex.
f.exceptions: Content must still comply with this guide.

f.statement: The PMR submission letter shall state the regulatory antecedent (the case of NOM-220 numeral 8.4.1 under which the PMR is submitted) and: generic name; distinctive name (harmonised throughout the document submitted in Mexico); pharmaceutical form; presentations; indication; registration number (if applicable); fraction of the medicine (if applicable); type, title and version of the proposed pharmacovigilance plan; CNFV revision number; and submission format (CD/USB).

f.title: Include the eight elements of the safety specification, justifying any missing information
f.statement: The safety specification shall comprise: general and regulatory information; basic pharmacological information; description of populations without safety information; available post-marketing safety information; safety information on off-label use, overdose, illegal use and medication errors; important risks; summary of safety concerns; and international alerts. Where information is not available, the corresponding justification shall be specified.

Descripción de poblaciones de las que no existe información de seguridad. 4. Información de seguridad post-comercialización disponible. 5. Información de seguridad de usos fuera de indicación autorizada, sobredosis, uso ilegal, errores de medicación. 6. Riesgos importantes. 7. Resumen de los problemas de seguridad. 8. Description of populations for which no safety information exists. 4. Available post-marketing safety information. 5. Safety information on off-label use, overdose, illegal use, medication errors. 6. Important risks. 7. Summary of safety concerns. 8. International alerts. If the information is not available, the corresponding justification shall be specified.

f.statement: The PMR shall include the national and international regulatory status of the medicine or vaccine (which may be presented as an annex), including the countries or regions where it is authorised.

f.statement: The regulatory status also gives the authorisation date per country or region (not when Mexico is the first country of registration), marketing status and start date (not when Mexico is the first country of marketing), and whether any other regulatory agency is assessing a safety concern; where indications were approved at different times, status is given separately per indication. International indications may be included as part of the global PMR, but it is indispensable to present the indications already approved in Mexico (with approval dates) and new indications applied for in Mexico, if applicable.

f.title: Describe composition, biological starting materials and each component of combinations
f.statement: The basic pharmacological information shall include a brief description of the composition (e.g. origin of active or biological ingredients, main adjuvants or residues for vaccines, other inert components); for biologicals and biotechnological products, data on starting materials (strain, seed, master and working bank system); and, for medicines with more than one active ingredient, the characteristics of each component (for combined vaccines, each antigenic component).

f.statement: Provide an executive description of: the target disease; the epidemiology of the indication (incidence and prevalence, natural history, demographics of the target population), including Mexico-specific information as far as possible, or stating why it is unavailable and giving international information; pathophysiology; risk factors; treatment options; comorbidities; and concomitant treatments of those comorbidities.

f.title: Update the PMR when safety concerns change

f.statement: If any national or international post-marketing study has been carried out, present its type and characteristics, justification, objective, population, duration, exposed patients (number and duration of exposure) and safety findings (final or interim report). rows.quote: En caso de que se haya llevado a cabo algún estudio post-comercialización (nacional o internacional) presentar la siguiente información:  Tipo y características.  Justificación.  Objetivo.  Población estudiada.  Duración.  Pacientes expuestos (número de pacientes y duración de la exposición).  Detallar hallazgos de seguridad (Reporte final o el Reporte parcial de resultados). f.title: Biologicals: address storage and distribution effects on efficacy and safety
f.statement: For biologicals, biotechnological products and biocomparables, information shall be presented on storage and distribution and how these could affect efficacy or safety (e.g. cold-chain breaks with stability results, photosensitivity, reconstitution problems).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: En el caso de biológicos, biotecnológicos y biocomparables se deberá presentar información respecto al almacenamiento y distribución del medicamento y cómo ésta podría afectar la eficacia o seguridad del producto, por ejemplo, ruptura de cadena de red fría (resultados de las pruebas de estabilidad), fotosensibilidad y alteraciones en la reconstitución, entre otras.

rows.quote_en: For biologicals, biotechnological products and biocomparables, information shall be presented on the storage and distribution of the medicine and how this could affect the efficacy or safety of the product, for example, cold-chain breaks (results of stability tests), photosensitivity and reconstitution problems, among others.

f.title: Generics: align safety specification with reference product, justifying discrepancies
f.statement: For generic products, the safety specification is expected to be the same as that of the reference product or of other generics with a PMR; where approved PMRs differ, the applicant is expected to propose and justify the most appropriate safety specification for its product.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: Para los productos genéricos, la expectativa es que las especificaciones de seguridad sean las mismas que aquellas del producto de referencia o de otros productos genéricos de los cuales exista un PMR. rows.quote_en: For generic products, the expectation is that the safety specification will be the same as that of the reference product or of other generic products for which a PMR exists. If there are discrepancies between the PMRs approved for such products, the applicant is expected to propose and justify the most appropriate safety specification for its product.

f.title: Generics: option to add or remove safety concerns with justification
f.statement: Exceptionally, the applicant for a new generic product may add or remove safety concerns relative to the reference product's safety profile if appropriately justified (e.g. a more up-to-date version than the reference profile, or differences in product characteristics such as an excipient present only in some products).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: Excepcionalmente, el solicitante de un nuevo producto genérico puede agregar o retirar preocupaciones de seguridad respecto al perfil de seguridad del producto de referencia, si esto se justifica apropiadamente (por ejemplo, cuando hay una versión más actualizada que el perfil de referencia o cuando hay diferencias entre las características del nuevo producto y el de referencia, como cuando el riesgo está asociado a un excipiente que está presente únicamente en algunos productosque contienen la misma sustancia activa).

f.title: Biocomparables: safety concerns at least equal to the reference product unless justified
f.statement: For biocomparable products, safety concerns must be at least the same as those of the reference product, except where justified (e.g. a reference-product risk linked to a component, manufacturing process or other factor absent in the biocomparable, or a concern specific to a use not shared with the reference product), always considering the potential for off-label use.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: En el caso de los productos biocomparables, las preocupaciones de seguridad deben ser, por lo menos, iguales a las del producto de referencia, excepto en aquellos casos donde esté justificado. Esta justificación puede incluir situaciones donde se sabe que un riesgo particular del producto de referencia está relacionado con un componente, el proceso de manufactura u otro factor que no está presente en el biocomparable o cuando la preocupación de seguridad es específica a un uso particular (por ejemplo, la vía de administración o la indicación) que no se comparte con el producto de referencia, siempre tomando en consideración el potencial de uso fuera de indicación.

rows.quote_en: For biocomparable products, the safety concerns must be at least the same as those of the reference product, except where justified. This justification may include situations where a particular risk of the reference product is known to be related to a component, the manufacturing process or another factor not present in the biocomparable, or where the safety concern is specific to a particular use (for example, route of administration or indication) not shared with the reference product, always taking into account the potential for off-label use.

f.title: Characterise each risk: type, frequency with 95% CI, seriousness and outcome
f.statement: For each risk, provide: type (identified or potential); frequency in clinical studies and during commercial life (if marketed), in absolute numbers and percentage with a 95% confidence interval; seriousness (number and percentage of serious events); and consequence/outcome, with clinical-study and marketed-product data where applicable.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: Para cada uno de los riesgos asociados al medicamento o vacuna en cuestión, se deberán proporcionar la siguiente información: 1. Tipo de riesgo (identificado o potencial). 2. Frecuencia. Presentar tanto la frecuencia con que se presentó durante los estudios clínicos, como la frecuencia con que se ha registrado durante la vida comercial del producto, si es que éste ya ha sido comercializado. Este dato deberá estar expresado tanto en números absolutos como porcentaje, con un intervalo de confianza del 95%. 3. Gravedad. Se deberá describir la gravedad de los eventos, en qué número y porcentaje se presentaron eventos graves. Al igual que la frecuencia, se deberá proporcionar información tanto de estudios clínicos como de producto comercializado, si aplica. 4. Consecuencia del riesgo. Describir el desenlace de los eventos, se deberá proporcionar información tanto de estudios clínicos como de producto comercializado, si aplica.

rows.quote_en: For each of the risks associated with the medicine or vaccine in question, the following information shall be provided: 1. Type of risk (identified or potential). 2. Frequency. Present both the frequency during clinical studies and the frequency recorded during the commercial life of the product, if it has already been marketed. This figure shall be expressed both in absolute numbers and as a percentage, with a 95% confidence interval. 3. Seriousness. The seriousness of the events shall be described, in what number and percentage serious events occurred. As with frequency, information from both clinical studies and the marketed product shall be provided, if applicable. 4. Consequence of the risk. Describe the outcome of the events; information from both clinical studies and the marketed product shall be provided, if applicable.

f.title: Characterise each risk: background incidence and risk factors
f.statement: For each risk, state whether it has a specific background incidence or prevalence in the target population that could make it more frequent than in the general population (if no specific incidence exists, general-population incidence may be given), and indicate predisposing risk groups or factors.

rows.quote: 6. Incidencia/prevalencia de base en la población objetivo o bien en la población general. rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico, or applicant for health registration / orphan-medicine recognition
rows.quote: Se deberán mencionar todas aquellas interacciones identificadas y potenciales asociadas al producto con otros medicamentos, medicamentos herbolarios, alimentos o suplementos alimenticios; el mecanismo biológico por el que se pueden generar interacciones (si no se presentó en los apartados de farmacocinética y farmacodinamia), así como el efecto que pueden generar en el paciente (por ejemplo, aumento o disminución de la efectividad terapéutica del producto o de la sustancia interactuante). rows.quote_en: All identified and potential interactions associated with the product with other medicines, herbal medicines, foods or food supplements shall be mentioned; the biological mechanism by which interactions may arise (if not presented in the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics sections), as well as the effect they may have on the patient (for example, increase or decrease in the therapeutic effectiveness of the product or of the interacting substance). For combinations, the risks for each of the active ingredients and the interaction between them shall be described.

f.title: Describe class-effect risks of the therapeutic class
f.statement: The risks characteristic of the product's therapeutic class shall be listed and described, indicating their frequency with other drugs, seriousness, severity and outcome, and the possibility of their occurring with the product if not yet described for it.
